WITH first_activity AS (
    SELECT 
        s.account_id,
        s.subscription_id,
        s.start_date AS sub_start,
        s.status AS sub_status,
        MIN(e.occurred_at) AS first_event_date

        sub_status,
        first_event_date,

    WHERE first_event_date IS NOT NULL
),
buckets AS (

        sub_status,
        CASE

    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN sub_status = 'churned' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS churn_rate_pct
